description:
Check a carrier registration form without filing anything.

        Takes the same arguments as ``submit_verification`` except ``attest_authorized``.
        Runs every check Hail can run before filing: purpose rules, credit (402),
        the carrier's current form, duplicates (409), field lengths, each file
        (type, size, and for ``upload_id`` that it is this workspace's verification
        document, uploaded within the last hour), and the form's required fields,
        documents and address (for ``purpose="sms"``, the US texting application).
        Nothing is filed, saved, held or charged, and uploads stay usable.
        Returns ``ok``, ``files`` (slot, upload_id, size_bytes, sha256 per file) and
        ``note``; problems come back as ``problems`` with the field named.
        The carrier runs its own checks at submission.

address.description: The applicant's address. Give it when the requirements include one; otherwise leave it out.
address.title: Address

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

documents.description: Map from each needed document slot to ``{option, fields}``, with the option chosen from that slot in the requirements.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Applicant answers keyed by the field names in ``get_verification_requirements``. Choice fields take comma-separated option keys.
fields.title: Fields

files.description: The document files, one per slot named in ``documents``. Use an upload: the ``id`` from ``create_file_upload`` with purpose ``verification_document``, within an hour of uploading. A very small file can go inline as base64 instead. Each file is at most 10 MiB.
files.title: Files

number_id.description: The owned number this registration is for: its ID from ``list_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Give it for toll-free texting and when the form asks for the sending number; otherwise leave it out.
number_id.title: Number Id

number_type.description: Kind of phone number: a local or mobile number, a national number (non-geographic), or a toll-free number.
number_type.title: Number Type

purpose.description: What the registration is for: ``number`` registers the applicant so a number can be bought; ``sms`` registers US texting (local 10DLC or toll-free).
purpose.title: Purpose

quote_id.description: The offer this registration is for: its ``quote_id`` from ``quote_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Give it when ``purpose`` is ``number``; leave it out for ``sms``.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

subject_type.description: Who the registration is for, matching the requirements: the user (``person``) or their company (``business``). It has no default; without it, nothing is sent.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

name: check_verification
title: Check a verification
